notes.text: Codification Sections 537 and 538, relating to Territory of Hawaii, were omitted in view of admission of Hawaii into the Union. Section 537, act Apr. 30, 1900, ch. 339, § 71, 31 Stat. 154, prescribed powers and duties of attorney general of Hawaii. Section 538, act Apr. 30, 1900, ch. 339, § 72, 31 Stat. 154, prescribed powers and duties of treasurer of Hawaii.
